traces.durability: IN_MEMORY_ONLY — the row lives in `globalThis`, dies with the container and is invisible to every other replica
traces.auditOutcome: NONE — `recordAuditEvent` is itself Prisma-backed, so no audit row can be written either
traces.reason: `update` — the exception path, caught with no log, metric or audit signal.
